title: mystic sages
tagline: Chat with the "mystic sages" to explore esoteric traditions. The characters are generated by chatgpt in conjunction with a dall-e tool connecting on-chain to Galadriel devnet.
description: Chat with the "mystic sages" to explore esoteric traditions. The characters are generated by chatgpt in conjunction with a dall-e tool connecting on-chain. The oracle of the Galadriel devnet can call dall-e image generation and gpt-4 chat. The retrieval augmented generation is what feeds the content of the sages knowledge by indexing leading esoteric books on specific topics and deriving the chatbots personality from this source.
how_its_made: First of all. I didn't finish my build. Its something I want to build so I will continue to learn to deliver a mvp. That's the goal. What I did. I had trouble setting up the project and the environment, lost a lot of time there. I made good use of perplexity to learn while I was building and coding. I got back at it on Saturday and learned how to do it and proceeded to create the rag pipeline foundation. I had to change the ingestion script to take my pdf's including book scans. Then I did a fast smart contract for the chat with rag. Already Sunday night by now. This morning I mocked up a next.js frontend. The functionality id not yet there but I have to wrap up for now. At least I have a frame to work from. I would like to finish my idea as delivering is a goal I have set for myself. It was an interesting endeavor to get back in to blockchain development after 6 months of python and ai stuff. Its is also the first web3 frontend for me ever, lol.
